headline: M&M files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure regarding substantial acquisition in MHRIL
sum: Mahindra and Mahindra has filed a mandatory takeover code disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in subsidiary Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited (MHRIL) triggering open offer or delisting threshold provisions.
detail: M&M submitted its Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 18 June 2026 regarding MHRIL, a listed resort and hospitality subsidiary. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires disclosure when a substantial acquisition (typically 25%+) has occurred, and ordinarily triggers an obligation to make an open offer to public shareholders at a specified price unless exempted. The disclosure filing is the formal regulatory step initiating takeover code compliance.
